items.prompt: What has been added to make the second verb?
options: Nothing: they have the same pattern
items.explanation: Akrama is on afʿala: a hamza is added before the root.

items.prompt: On which pattern is the maṣdar of the bāb of faʿʿala?
items.explanation: ʿAllama has the maṣdar taʿlīm, on tafʿīl; hence the name bāb al-tafʿīl.

items.prompt: Which of these verbs is mazīd?
items.explanation: ʿAllama doubles the ʿayn of the root; ʿalima is bare.
